s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a cream sofa behind them and the back of a teal armchair in the foreground

beats.text: Polly walks in from the left gazing at {ifin} in her flippers while Pax sits on the sofa holding a teal remote
Polly stops in front of the sofa and holds the phone out to Pax
Pax takes the phone from Polly while she turns away with her eyes closed and a smile

spans.notes: camera locked f0-30 (foreground armchair band pixel-identical; compare 0/30 sofa and armchair edges overlap). Polly is cut by the left edge at f0-2 as she walks in. Phone: pale grey back, three lenses, tuft = iFin; its back faces the viewer, so no screen content shows. The push-in starts at f31

push-in f31-35 (armchair band diff to previous 3.6, 7.2, 9.5, 8.8, 9.3, then 0 from f37; settled at f36) while Polly hops onto the sofa beside Pax, then 13 locked frames f36-48 of the two sitting side by side. 18 frames in all

phone point of view: phone-screen insert: the iFin held in Pax's flippers fills the picture, its photo gallery showing a picture of Polly (also a lead_copy); only Pax's flippers visible; dropped as lead_copy (curator ruling: a phone POV with the other lead on its screen)

spans.view: with the cream sofa behind him and a teal remote lying beside him

beats.text: Pax sits on the sofa clutching {ifin} to his chest in both flippers, glancing sideways with wide eyes

spans.notes: camera locked (sofa and wall bands pixel-identical f91-120). The phone's back faces the viewer: no screen content visible

phone point of view: phone-screen insert again, closer: the gallery photo of Polly fills the phone screen (also a lead_copy), Pax's flippers holding it; thumbnails along the bottom; dropped as lead_copy (curator ruling: a phone POV with the other lead on its screen)

beats.text: Pax glares ahead with narrowed eyes and a frown, holding {ifin} up in front of him
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and dips his head slightly
Pax opens his eyes and raises one eyebrow with a doubtful frown

spans.notes: camera locked: the phone held in the (soft-focus) foreground keeps its edges in compare 174/198 and 198/205; only Pax's face moves. profile's cut candidate at f199 is the expression change, not a cut. Phone back faces the viewer

20 locked frames (armchair band identical f211-249): Polly sits on the sofa with her flippers clasped, looking at Pax, while Pax looks at the phone and then lifts it to his face; at f231 he turns the screen to the viewer, see next span

19 frames, also lead_copy: Pax holds the phone out toward Polly with its screen to the viewer, showing the photo of Polly (f231-249), and gestures at her with his other flipper while she watches. Skit ends here
